values.note: 'Campsites can be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office during operational hours.' The park page allows one night Sunday-Thursday, but the booking site refused every one-night stay tested for 2027 (weeknights in January, March, April, May, June and August; a Sunday in June) while selling all six sites for two nights on the same dates; only a few November 2026 weeknights sold a single night on one or two sites. Call the forest office (304-938-2252) for a one-night stay.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/panther-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-panther-state-forest/ ('Campsites can be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office during operational hours.', 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night during the week (Sunday-Thursday).', 'Visitors may not book sites for more than 14 consecutive nights.') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067662 (one-night stays 2027-01-12, 2027-03-30, 2027-04-06, 2027-04-20, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-13, 2027-06-15, 2027-08-10: none offered; two nights 2027-01-12, 2027-03-09, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15, 2027-06-18 (Fri-Sat), 2027-08-10: all 6 sites; one night 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-10: 1-2 sites), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All six campsites have electric, so the range is the electric sites' price on the WV State Parks booking site: $29.99 a night for 2027 stays (January to August, weeknights and weekends alike) and $34.99 for November 2026 nights.

fees.source: https://book.wvstateparks.com/Ecomm/Listings/SupplierTile/7816932/en-US?supplierId=11067662 (Panther State Forest Electric Campsites, Sites 1-6: $29.99 for 2026-12-08, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-09, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15, 2027-06-18 and 2027-08-10 stays; $34.99 for 2026-11-03, 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-24), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/panther-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-panther-state-forest/ ('Each campsite is located along Panther Creek and equipped with: An electrical hookup, Fireplaces, Picnic tables'; 'Water access is available at the park office, roughly 2.5 miles from the campground.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Camping page confirms the inherited booking rules (online/phone/office, 2-night weekend minimum, 14-night maximum) into the entry; fees $29.99-34.99 read from the booking site (all six sites electric); 6 sites, no water at the sites or the campground (office 2.5 miles away). Season (year-round) already verified.
flags: Booking site vs park page: the page allows one night Sunday-Thursday, but book.wvstateparks.com sold no one-night stay on any 2027 date tested (8 weeknights and a Sunday) while selling all six sites for two nights on the same dates. Recorded only the page's weekend minimum; a de-facto 2-night minimum online may need a human look (or a call to 304-938-2252).
